name: Yakan Shinryou ~Nurse Choukyou Karte~
original_name: 夜姦診療～ナース調教カルテ～
source:
Kazuki is a medical student, who's just started working as a part-timer at a clinic where his cousin, Haruka, works. On his first day at work, he meets Haruka and she shows him around the clinic. He meets beautiful nurses, Yuuhi, Misao, Rina and Ayase, there and gets excited to work with them. But he has a secret..., dark personality....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
一树是一名医学生，刚刚开始在表姐遥工作的诊所兼职。上班第一天，他见到遥，由她带领参观诊所。他在那里遇见优姬、美纱绪、里奈与绫濑几名美丽护士，对和她们共事充满期待。但他有一个秘密…一副阴暗的人格…

[摘自ErogeShop]
